lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits. lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, forming a series of grid-like anchor nodes across the lateral surface where the circular blobs are centered.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow-induced lower intensity on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains several small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs distributed irregularly across the surface, though they appear less distinct and more blurred compared to the primary flank patterning.
